title: Shiraishi An — The Time Has Come〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright, that's everyone.
Let's get going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
Before we do, Kohane and I need to tell you guys something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's really important...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and I are fighting!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Shiraishi, Azusawa, but what do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, yesterday...
An's Room

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm so glad Kohane and I did that battle today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel like we've become a lot more like Nagi and her team now. We're partners who are gonna keep pushing each other to become better.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it, they used to argue all the time. Over the littlest things too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, our team's never really had a serious fight. Not like those three...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I mean, Kohane's just way too nice a person. I can't see her getting into a big argument with someone...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But it might be good for us to shout at each other for a change...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Arguing can sometimes help people find solutions to their problems. Like what I was dealing with until today!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Plus, they say the closer you are with someone, the more you fight!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright.
My mind's made up, so it's time to let Kohane know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, in order for Kohane and me to become better partners, we're gonna try having a fight!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why we need all of you to play along.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Also, don't worry about the event.
We'll stay focused on singing like always! Right, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Let's do our best, An!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still don't really get what's going on, but... Suit yourselves.
A few hours later
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Phew...
We all managed to put on the best performance we could today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and the crowd reacted to us pretty well. Let's try to achieve the same result tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
This has nothing to do with the event...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But what's up with those two today? Are they...having a fight or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're not sure either...
They basically just didn't talk in the car.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But they seemed more in sync than usual during the event. Was it the result of that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I doubt it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I mean, based on the performance they put on, they might've forgotten what they were fighting about...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane! Nice job today!
Let's go grab some drinks together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We all did great today.
The crowd responded really well and... No, wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I forgot that Kohane and I were supposed to go back to fighting when the event finished. I can't act like my usual self!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I, uhh... What I meant was—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You go get a drink by yourself, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
H-Hmph!
Then, I'm not getting you anything!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't want one. Also, I didn't ask!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wh-Whoa... I'm not used to this salty Kohane...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I feel so conflicted...
What she's doing is really cute, but I don't like being on the receiving end...)
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know we agreed to stop doing this at seven...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(B-But I can't take it anymore...!
Yes, I suggested that we do this, but I'm starting to think that I should just apologize and—)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't take it anymore!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All finished?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, An!
I feel awful about ignoring you and saying those terrible things...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
M-Me too...
I didn't mean for things to get so tense.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, it was all my fault!
I really didn't know how to be mean and prickly...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, Azusawa, you weren't really all that scary.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But you definitely had an effect on Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course it did! Kohane's always so sweet and gentle! Seeing her not smile was painful...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It just goes to show that fighting isn't a good idea...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm glad we did this little test run.
Because now I don't want us to have another fight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I already knew this...
But you mean way too much to me, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks...
You mean a lot to me too, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've made up, let's go grab something to eat! There's so much I didn't get to talk to you about today...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Same here...!
But we can do all the talking we want now!
